subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Names body parts and the actions the body can do; identifies basic rights and responsibilities

show.line: This is my body! Head, shoulders, knees and toes. Eyes, ears, mouth and nose!

rounds.praise: Yes! A hand. We wave with our hands.

rounds.prompt: We walk with these. Tap the feet.
rounds.praise: Feet! We walk and run with our feet.

rounds.prompt: Touch your nose. What is it called?
rounds.praise: Nose! We smell with our nose.
Eyes! We see with our eyes.

rounds.prompt: Is it on your head, or on your legs? Sort them.
Show me what your body can do. Jump, clap or wave. What did you do?

hints: Point to the part on your own body first.
Head parts are up high. Leg parts are down low.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this part.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is my knee. My elbow is on my arm.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Knee. It bends my leg!

parent_line: Can name body parts and say what the body can do.
